supersedes_observation_classification_on.note: The prior boundary and its conditions remain immutable. This addendum replaces the earlier unresolved/intermittent classification with a reproduced, diagnosed blocker.

reproduction.stack_path: Pixi position.x -> clusterHorizontalCollisions sort -> throttled runEvents layout callback
reproduction.conclusion: The error occurs three milliseconds after the TaskRun view becomes visible and before context close. The corrected probe therefore reproduces an application teardown race rather than merely observing browser-close noise.

source_provenance.classification: The affected graph factory bytes match upstream commit 87b5243 and predate native integration. This provenance does not waive the defect: the integrated UI acceptance exercises the path and requires it to be fixed.

root_cause: A trailing lodash.throttle layout callback and/or async factory continuation survives destruction of the owning Pixi container. It later sorts graph elements whose Pixi position is already null. Existing event subscription teardown was also incomplete; the artifacts factory has the analogous lifecycle pattern.
approved_fix_boundary: Track owner/container disposal and make render, update and async continuations fail closed after destruction.
Cancel pending throttled layout callbacks on destruction.
Remove registered emitter listeners on destruction.
Check owner liveness after awaited collision/factory work, not only before awaiting.
Destroy a factory element that resolves after its owner was disposed instead of attaching it.
Apply the same lifecycle discipline to runArtifacts where it has the same throttled/async ownership pattern.
Do not modify backend, streaming protocol or accepted Python runtime to mask the browser error.
required_regressions: Use real Pixi containers and real lodash.throttle to prove a queued trailing callback cannot read or render destroyed nodes.
Prove listener removal and throttle cancellation on destroy.
Prove a factory resolving after owner destruction is destroyed and never attached.
Preserve the corrected live probe timing/stack report and its injected-late-error negative control.
Retain the real before-fix failure and run a fresh packaged actual PostgreSQL/ProcessWorker 8-document successor with zero final page errors after context/browser close.
Repeat full UI unit, browser, typecheck, lint, format, build and exact served-asset checks.
Bind changed UI and probe paths through a successor source manifest; backend/Python evidence may be reused only through explicit byte relevance.
Require hosted CI and CodeQL on the final source.
acceptance_after_fix: If all required regressions and hosted gates pass, this defect can close without invalidating the already source-bound native storage, execution or worker evidence. The original failed browser observation remains retained and the final review must cite this addendum.
not_claimed: The cause is not dismissed as harmless teardown noise.
Twenty-four earlier clean replays do not override the reproduced failure.
Upstream provenance does not convert a confirmed integrated UI defect into an accepted limitation.
